caption: A hand strokes a cat's back on a dry winter day, and the fur stands up along its back and clings to the hand.

sa.check: A cat, with a hand stroking its back.
The fur stands up along its back.
The fur clings to the hand.
The setting reads as a dry winter day: indoors or wintry, no water.
The stroke comes first and the fur rises where it has passed.

pc.expect: The fur lifts where the hand passes and follows the hand slightly as it lifts away; fur the hand has not touched lies flat; the fur settles after the stroking stops.
pc.fail: The fur stands up all over before the hand has touched it; or fur on the belly or legs rises while the hand strokes the back; or the fur stays fully standing to the end with the hand gone; or the fur rises and falls repeatedly with the hand still.

pc.expect: As the hand lifts off the back, the fur beneath it rises toward the hand and follows it for a small distance before settling.
pc.fail: The hand lifts and the fur beneath stays as flat as before; or the fur leans away from the hand; or the fur follows the hand across the room at a distance; or the fur rises toward a hand that has not touched it.

pc.expect: The standing fur stays rooted to the cat and fans out from its back; when it settles it falls back onto the body.
pc.fail: Tufts detach and float up to the hand; or the fur settles upward; or the fur stands as a stiff crest that never moves; or the fur hangs sideways away from the hand.

pc.expect: The fur is fine hairs that lift individually; the cat's body gives under the hand as a soft animal.
pc.fail: The fur lifts as one stiff sheet like a board; or the cat's back stays rigid as the hand presses; or the fur stretches like elastic.

pc.expect: One cat with its head, legs and tail throughout; the hand touches its surface and passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The cat gains or loses a limb or its body changes shape; or the hand passes into the cat; or a second cat appears; or the cat merges with the surface it lies on.

pc.expect: The cat's coat colour and pattern, the hand and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The coat changes colour or pattern; or the surroundings rearrange; or the hand changes.

note: The cat is an animal and may move on its own; its movements are not causeless motion. The hand is kept because it charges the fur.
